pages.title: The Sunward
pages.text: Sunflower · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Sunflower Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)The sunflower is mine.$(br2)— Vincent van Gogh

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Regenerates under the open day sky; glows at night.$(br2)$(br2)Sunward 3:00
